paper.title: Adapting to Decision-Relevant Non-Stationarity in Decentralized Heterogeneous Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Decentralized heterogeneous bandits with decision-relevant non-stationarity (dynamic consensus regret)
unmapped: N agents with heterogeneous, time-varying local means communicating over a random graph; flooding time D_G(delta) assumed (Assumption 2), learner uses D_G and N

Local means may change arbitrarily often (S_loc changes); only the best arm of the agent-average reward switches S_dec times, with sign-stable global gaps within each regime (not piecewise stationary)
Mean path oblivious (F_0-measurable); cross-agent independent noise
Minimum decision-regime length L_min >= M + 2 H_scan + D_G(delta/3)

settings.name_in_paper: Decentralized heterogeneous bandits with decision switches (lower bound)
unmapped: N agents communicating over a graph (broom graph of diameter D_G for the propagation part)
Homogeneous Bernoulli instances with S_dec best-arm switches
settings.definition_quote: Fix margin $\Delta\in(0,1/8)$ and sufficiently long regimes. There are constants $c_{\mathrm c},c_{\mathrm g}>0$ and two different homogeneous instance families

settings.name_in_paper: Decentralized heterogeneous bandits, unknown gap (Gap-Adaptive DRFC)
unmapped: Same as s1 but no prior gap knowledge; margin floor underline Delta <= min_r Delta_min^(r)/2 used
Regime-length condition in terms of running-minimum gap
settings.definition_quote: Its sole purpose is to remove prior knowledge of $\Delta_{\min}$ from the scan-budget calibration.

unmapped: Comparator is the regime-average best arm a_r^avg over S_dec^avg average-decision regimes, not instantaneous best arm
Window-average margin condition (Assumption 4) with window W and margin bar Delta; instantaneous gaps may change sign
Learner uses window length W satisfying the margin condition and flooding time D_G(alpha)

bound.expression: N*K*(h + D_G)*T/M + Sum_cert_mon + N*S_dec*(M + H_scan + D_G)

symbols.h: block size (pulls per arm per agent per block)
symbols.S_dec: number of switches of the best common (agent-average) arm
symbols.Sum_cert_mon: sum_{r=0}^{S_dec} (1 + L_r/M) * C_r, with C_r = sum_{a != a_r*} Gamma_a^(r)/(Delta_a^(r))^2 and L_r the regime length

conditions: Assumptions 1-3 (oblivious bounded rewards, flooding, minimum regime length)
unique best common arm at every round; sign-stable global gaps within regimes
lower bounds on gaps known for scan-budget calibration
tuning: H_scan chosen by Corollary 1 scan-budget calibration

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Under Assumptions~\ref{ass:rewards}, \ref{ass:flooding}, and~\ref{ass:min-regime}, and the decision regimes of Definition~\ref{ass:regimes}, choose $\Hscan$ by Corollary~\ref{cor:scan-calibration}. If $L_{\min}\ge M+2\Hscan+\DG(\delta/3)$, then DRFC satisfies w.p.\ $\geq 1-\delta$ R_T=\widetilde{O}(...)

results.notes: Probability >= 1-delta. Theorem 5 in supplement restates the same bound in detailed form. No S_loc term.

bound.regime: L_r >= d_probe + H_scan + D_G(delta/3) for every regime

symbols.q_p: number of probe blocks per monitoring event
symbols.h_probe: pulls per arm per agent in a probe block
symbols.d_probe: worst-case delay from a decision boundary to the first suspicious probe (<= M + q_p*K*h_probe)
symbols.Sum_cert: sum_{r=0}^{S_dec} C_r, C_r = sum_{a != a_r*} Gamma_a^(r)/(Delta_a^(r))^2

conditions: assumptions of Theorem 1
(2+lambda_p)*beta_p < Delta_min (no false trigger)

source.label: cor:probe-main
source.quote: Under the assumptions of Theorem~\ref{thm:main}, suppose $(2+\lambda_p)\beta_p<\Delta_{\min}$, so a correct cached candidate causes no false trigger, and the regime-length condition above holds. Then, w.p.\ $\geq1-\delta$, every confirming scan is contained in one decision regime and R_T=\widetilde O(...)

results.notes: Removes the N S_dec H_scan boundary term.

bound.regime: Delta in (0,1/8); regimes long enough (Omega(K log T/(N Delta^2)) certification room)

symbols.D_G: graph diameter / flooding time of broom graph

conditions: algorithm is rate-consistent (per-regime suboptimal pull counts <= C_alg log T on every instance of family) AND in decentralized graph-communication class
two-instance minimax: instance from union of a homogeneous K-arm certification family and a broom-graph family
propagation part requires K>=3, N>=4, D_G <= N/4, Delta <= 1/(8 sqrt(N D_G))
homogeneous Bernoulli rewards

source.label: thm:info
source.quote: Fix margin $\Delta\in(0,1/8)$ and sufficiently long regimes. There are constants $c_{\mathrm c},c_{\mathrm g}>0$ and two different homogeneous instance families ... every algorithm in the intersection faces an instance in their union satisfying \E[R_T]\geq\max\{A,B\}\geq\tfrac12(A+B).

results.notes: Not an additive single-instance lower bound. Certification part holds for rate-consistent algorithms (incl. centralized); propagation part for decentralized graph-communication algorithms.

symbols.S_loc: number of rounds at which some local mean changes

conditions: protocols in the local-change-reactive class (must reset after sufficiently many agents experience local jumps)
cancellation instance with K=2
bound is on reset regret or control-communication cost

source.label: thm:separation
source.quote: For the class of protocols required to reset after sufficiently many agents experience local jumps, there is a cancellation instance with $\Stdec=0$ and $\Stloc=\Theta(T/L)$ on which every such protocol pays $\Omega(\Stloc)$ reset regret or control-communication cost

results.notes: Class-relative illustrative separation; cost is either regret or communication; supplement gives Omega((1-eta) S_loc c_reset).

bound.regime: W*h >= n_0(bar Delta); each regime contains at least 2W probe blocks

symbols.W: sliding window length in probe blocks
symbols.Sum_cert_seq: sum_{r=0}^{S_dec_avg} C_r^seq with C_r^seq = O_tilde(K/bar Delta_r^2)

conditions: Assumptions 1, 2, 4 (window-average margin bar Delta)
regret measured against regime-average best arm a_r^avg

source.label: thm:drfc-seq
source.quote: Run DRFC-Seq with a sliding window of $W$ balanced blocks, probe gap $\delta_{\mathrm{p}}$, and radius $r_n$. ... Its decision regret satisfies R_T^{\mathrm{dec}}=\widetilde O(...)

results.notes: Decision regret against piecewise-constant regime-average comparator; mapped to switching_regret/best_switching_sequence approximately. Holds on good event of probability >= 1-alpha (correctness part). Theorem also states no-false-switch correctness w.p. 1-alpha (not recorded).

bound.regime: L_r >= d_probe + H_scan + D_G(delta/3) for every regime

symbols.Sum_cert_F: sum_r (1+F_r) C_r with F_r the number of false-triggered scans in regime r
symbols.F_partial: number of boundary-straddling false-triggered scans (<= sum_r F_r)

conditions: main reward, flooding and sign-stable regime assumptions

source.label: thm:app-probe
source.quote: Under the main reward, flooding, and sign-stable regime assumptions, replace the minimum-regime condition by \Lreg_r\geq d_{\mathrm{probe}}+\Hscan+\DG(\delta/3) ... Then DRFC-Probe satisfies on the good event R_T=...

results.notes: General version with false-trigger budget; no-false-trigger specialization equals Corollary 2 (r2). 'On the good event' (prob >= 1-delta).

bound.regime: K>=3, N>=4, S_dec>=1, Delta in (0,1/8), D_G <= N/4, Delta <= 1/(8 sqrt(N D_G))

conditions: stationary-margin family: constant global gaps per regime with Gamma^(r) = Theta(Delta), minimum margin Delta
regime length >= max(d_probe + H_scan + D_G(delta/3), c_0 K log T/(N Delta^2))
probe calibration q_p K h_probe <= H_scan
tuning: M and probe size held fixed

source.label: cor:app-minimax
source.quote: no-false-trigger DRFC-Probe attains on the good event R_T=\widetilde O(...) ... Hence the switch-induced, gap-dependent part of $R_T$ is R_T^{\mathrm{switch}}=\widetilde\Theta\!\big(\Stdec(K-1)/\Delta+N\Stdec\DG\Delta\big)

results.notes: Claims matching Theorem 2 lower bound for the switch-induced part (in the two-instance sense).

bound.regime: rho_{r+1} - rho_r >= M + C_db*H_scan(tilde Delta_min^(r)) + D_G(delta/3)

symbols.Sum_Hscan_tilde: sum_{r=0}^{S_dec} H_scan(tilde Delta_min^(r)), scan budget at running-minimum gap

conditions: main reward, flooding, and sign-stable regime conditions
floor underline Delta <= min_r Delta_min^(r)/2
tuning: optimistic initial margin guess Delta^(0) in (0,1)

source.label: prop:app-gap-adaptive
source.quote: Then Gap-Adaptive DRFC, run with arbitrary optimistic guess $\Delta^{(0)}\in(0,1)$ and floor $\underline\Delta\leq\min_r\Delta_{\min}^{(r)}/2$, ... satisfies with probability at least $1-\delta$ R_T=\widetilde{O}(...)

results.notes: Removes prior gap knowledge; floor itself is a parameter (e.g. 1/T).

symbols.Sum_rec_mon: sum_r (1+L_r/M) B_r with B_r = sum_{a != a_r*} 1/(h (Delta_a^(r))^2)

conditions: on the good event

source.label: prop:app-records
source.quote: On the good event, conservative active-set DRFC creates, up to logarithmic factors, at most ... distinct source-traceable comparison and switch records.

results.notes: Communication complexity (number of distinct source records), not regret. Probe variant bound also given in same proposition (not recorded separately).
